description: This file defines a utility class for logging, providing static methods to forward log messages to a linked list of LogNode objects. It contains definitions for various log levels, getter/setter for the LogNode, and convenience methods for different log priorities.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class that provides static methods for logging at various levels and manages the chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which logs will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message with ASSERT priority with optional Throwable.
